Lone Larsen is a chief physician, PhD, and clinical lecturer who serves as the chair of the [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]] (Steering Committee for DANIBD) [^src1] [^src3]. In this capacity, she is the leading professional and administrative figure responsible for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Diseases) initiative [^src2]. She formally signs the conclusions of the database's annual reports on behalf of the steering committee, underscoring her central role in guiding the national quality monitoring of IBD treatments in Denmark [^src1] [^src3].

**Disambiguation**: This Lone Larsen is specifically identified by her medical and academic titles (chief physician, PhD, clinical lecturer) and her affiliation with Region Nordjylland and the RKKP (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram). She should not be confused with other individuals sharing the same name who lack these credentials or connections to DANIBD [^src1] [^src2].

Larsen's leadership is documented across multiple reporting periods for the DANIBD initiative. She chaired the steering committee during the preparation of the database's inaugural annual report, which covered the period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023 [^src1] [^src2]. She continued in this role for the second annual report, covering the period from October 1, 2023, to September 30, 2024, which marked the first time results for all seven quality indicators were presented [^src3]. Through her position, she oversees the strategic direction of the database, which aims to systematize and improve IBD treatment across Danish regions through cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and evidence-based guidelines [^src1] [^src3].
